frictions.description: Customer quota (max_active_per_customer=5) interferes with batch testing when other subagents are running concurrently on the same customer (cust_example). First batch test failed 2/3 alerts due to quota, requiring cleanup and retry.
frictions.resolution: Withdrew mitigations created by previous tests to free quota, then retried batch test successfully.

blockers.description: auth_mode=none in the running configuration prevents testing 401 authentication enforcement on /v1/signals/alertmanager
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Confirmed auth_mode=none via GET /v1/health. Cannot change auth mode without affecting other concurrent subagents per isolation rules.

summary: Tested 11 assertions: 10 passed, 0 failed, 1 blocked (VAL-ADAPT-010: auth_mode=none prevents testing auth enforcement). All Alertmanager adapter behaviors working correctly: valid webhook acceptance, batch processing, vector/IP/severity mapping, BPS/PPS parsing, resolved alert withdrawal, fingerprint dedup, malformed payload rejection, and partial batch failure handling.
